Cats can be very good at hiding digestive upsets. However, you can find clues in their litter box. Lots of stinky, runny stools could mean your adult cat has a sensitive stomach, particularly a sensitive lower digestive tract. Your cat could be having a hard time digesting food properly—and it’s time to consult your vet. 

Royal Canin Sensitive Digestion dry cat food is tailored nutrition made to support for your cat’s sensitive tummy. Prebiotics and highly digestible proteins promote healthy digestion and a balanced intestinal tract so that your feasting feline can enjoy their food comfortably. Three unique kibble shapes offer maximum appetite appeal. And because this formula contains a higher energy density, they can eat smaller meals to support digestive sensitivities. Try pairing with Royal Canin Digest Sensitive wet cat food formulas for a meal your cat will love.

And highly digestible proteins, including a blend of prebiotics and dietary fibers, help balance the intestinal tract for healthy digestion. sections.bodyString: ORIJEN Original Cat Food provides peak nourishment with a protein-rich recipe to help your cat thrive. Just like their ancestors, modern cats benefit from a diet rich in protein and fat sourced from a variety of animal ingredients. This grain free dry cat food kibble offers a biologically appropriate recipe including probiotics, Omega fatty acids and Taurine to help support digestion, a shiny coat, healthy skin and heart health. Made with 90 percent animal ingredients*, this high protein cat food features an authentic ORIJEN WholePrey recipe with the most nutrient-dense, succulent parts of the prey to deliver the nutrition cats need. The first five ingredients of this ORIJEN cat food are fresh or raw** free-run*** chicken and turkey, whole mackerel, turkey giblets and flounder, providing a strong source of essential protein, vitamins, and minerals. This great-tasting kibble is also freeze-dried coated for a burst of raw flavor your cat instinctively craves. Nourish as Nature Intended. *Approximate and derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients **Our fresh ingredients use refrigeration as the sole method of preservation and our raw ingredients are frozen at their peak freshness ***Our free-run chickens and turkeys are not housed in cages and are able to move in a barn without outdoor access

We also recommend feeding your cat twice daily and always keeping fresh, clean water available. When switching diets, it's important to transition your cat or kitten as it takes time for their digestive system to adapt to the richer nutrient levels in ORIJEN™. NutriSource dry food recipes contain 15 feline-specific ingredients and supplements to improve digestion and keep your furry friend’s motor running. Cats are carnivores—they thrive on protein and fat, but their gut bacteria need more ingredients for optimal digestion and longevity. Fuel your cat’s health and happiness with science-backed nutrition! NutriSource dry food recipes contain 15 feline-specific ingredients and supplements to improve digestion and keep your furry friend’s motor running. Cats are carnivores—they thrive on protein and fat, but their gut bacteria need more ingredients for optimal digestion and longevity. Our recipes support superior health by nurturing beneficial gut bacteria, boosting immunity and overall well-being. We’re never going to have the shortest list of ingredients on the back of our pet food products because we add more for digestion and immunity, which we believe is a recipe for happiness! • 43% protein from deboned chicken and salmon

sections.bodyString: And I think to myself, what a 'wonderful' fish. Tilapia nilotica, "fish of the Nile," plays a fascinating historical role. Evidence, in the form of hieroglyphic paintings and carvings suggest that not only was tilapia harvested by ancient Egyptians, tilapia was the food of many Pharaohs. Because biblical tradition holds that tilapia was the fish Jesus multiplied and fed to the masses, some have come to know tilapia as "St. Peter's Fish" or "Wonder Fish."

This product is intended for intermittent or supplemental feeding only. Not for human consumption.

Directions for Feeding: KMR 2nd Step should be lapped out of a bowl, not fed from a bottle. KMR 2nd Step has been formulated to meet the nutritional needs of young kittens being weaned from mother, or bottle fed kittens progressing to solid foods. For best results the product should be mixed with ready to feed liquid KMR or reconstituted powder KMR to give the consistency necessary to get good food consumption. If KMR is not available water may be used. Fresh, clean water should always be available for drinking. It is recommended that KMR 2nd Step be fed until kittens are seven or eight weeks old when they can be fed commercial kitten or cat food as desired. All changes in diet should be made gradually over a period of one week. Mixing Directions: Kittens that are up on their feet and lapping from a bowl may be introduced to KMR 2nd Step. Begin by offering it as a thin gruel. Determine the amount of KMR 2nd Step powder to be fed to the kitten at each feeding using the Feeding Guidelines below. Reconstitute powder by using three parts (a part is any measuring device, i.e. teaspoon, tablespoon or cup) liquid KMR or water to one part powder for the first few days. Offer only small amounts and remove the uneaten portion after no more than 20 minutes. Kittens should be fed three times per day. Weigh the kittens at least once a week to monitor weight gain and adequacy of feeding. As kittens grow, decrease the amount of water mined with the powder until weaning food is an oatmeal consistency. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. Feeding Guidelines: Small kittens (8 oz average); 2 teaspoon powder. Medium kittens (1-1/2 lbs average); 2 tablespoons powder. Large kittens (3 lb average); 4 tablespoon powder. More or less food may be needed by individual kittens to satisfy their food require food for optimum performance. Storage: Powder does not need to be refrigerated, but should be kept covered and stored in a cool, dry place. Avoid exposure to excessive temperatures. Use before date stamped.

Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Cat & Kitten Chicken Meal, Salmon & Liver Recipe includes a blend of chicken, salmon, liver and rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Cat Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• Chicken meal is the #1 ingredient.

Directions for Mixing KMR Powder: Gently stir or shake 1 part powdered KMR into 2 parts warm water (a part may be a teaspoon, tablespoon or cup). Do not mix more KMR than can be consumed in 24 hours. Do not use a blender. Reconstituted KMR should be kept refrigerated. One 12 oz. (340g) can of powder makes approximately 60 oz. (1.7L) of liquid mixed 1:2. Directions for Feeding: All kittens should receive their mother's milk for at least 2 days, if possible. This colostrum milk gives extra nutrition and temporary immunity against some diseases. Warm reconstituted KMR to room or body temperature before serving. Feed kittens 2 tablespoons (30mL) of liquid KMR per 4 ounces (115g) of body weight daily. The daily feeding amount should be divided into equal portions for each feeding. Kittens' needs will vary and this amount may have to be increased or decreased depending on the individual. Young and/or weak kittens should be fed every 3 to 4 hours. Older kittens can do well being fed every 8 hours. Weigh the kittens 3 times per week to assure adequate feeding. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. The PetAg 2 oz. (60mL) small Animal Nurser is suited for feeding most kittens. When kittens are old enough to lap, begin offering reconstituted IVAR in a saucer. During the 5th week mix reconstituted KMR with KMR 2nd step Kitten Weaning Food. Use of the KMR and 2nd Step will allow the kitten to be gradually switched to solid food. Pregnant and lactating queens: Feed 2 teaspoons (4g) KMR Powder per 5 lbs. (2.2kg) body weight daily. Growing kittens already on solid food, show cats, and/or convalescing cats: Feed 1 teaspoon (2g) KMR Powder per 5 lbs. (2.2kg) body weight daily by top dressing food. Storage: Unopened powder should be stored in a cool, dry place. Reconstituted liquid must be kept refrigerated for up to 24 hours. Opened powder must be refrigerated for up to 3 months, or can be frozen for up to 6 months to preserve freshness. Use before date stamped.

sections.bodyString: Here at Inaba, we know your cat is a beloved family member. That's why each of our Churu Lickable Creamy Purée Natural Cat Treats are made from high-quality ingredients, including wild-caught tuna and farm-raised chicken. Since cats are not naturally drawn to water, we have made these a high-moisture, low calorie cat treat that your kitties will love. They contain 91% moisture and have only 6 calories per tube. That's a tenth of the calories of traditional dry cat treats and more than 1000 times the moisture (8% vs. 91% moisture). In addition, we've also added Taurine to help with their vision, digestions and heart health, as well as, Vitamin E for immunity and Green Tea Extract for its natural antioxidants. What they're missing? They're grain-free, preservative-free, carrageenan-free and free from artificial colors, making them a cat treat you can feel good about feeding. Designed to be hand fed, you can use to help calm the feistiest of outdoor ferals or treat your pampered indoor pussycat. sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Small & Medium Breed Puppy Food includes a blend of chicken, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages excluding growth of large size dogs (70 lbs. or more as an adult). 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Large Breed Adult Chicken & Rice Recipe Dog Food includes a blend of chicken, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages.

Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Adult Chicken & Rice includes a blend of Chicken, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion.

• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, chicken free, NutriSource Turkey & Rice includes a blend of turkey, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive, chicken free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty. At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition. That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Scientifically formulated and solution-focused, PureVita Turkey & Cranberry Puppy Food combines tasty real turkey, cranberries and a select variety of other nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource PureVita puppy diets are specially formulated to support cognitive balance, training & behavior, and longevity & quality of life from day one.

• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, chicken free, NutriSource Beef & Rice includes a blend of beef, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages excluding growth of large size dogs (70 lbs. or more as an adult). 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.  
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive, chicken free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Trout & Rice Recipe Dog Food includes a blend of trout, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty. At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition. That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. • Family owned means we make decisions based on what's best for your family pets!

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Trout & Rice Recipe Dog Food includes a blend of trout, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, chicken free, Large Breed NutriSource Beef & Rice includes a blend of beef, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive, chicken free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Large Breed Puppy Grain Free Dog Food includes a blend of turkey, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.

• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, chicken free, NutriSource Turkey & Rice includes a blend of turkey, rice, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive, chicken free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Senior Chicken & Rice Recipe Dog Food includes a blend of chicken, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here. • DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString: Support your large breed puppy’s rapid growth and development with ORIJEN AMAZING GRAINS Puppy Large Dry Dog Food. This large breed dog food kibble provides peak nutrition for your growing puppy, including DHA and EPA from pollock oil to support a healthy immune function. Each serving of this ORIJEN dog food for puppies contains omega 3-rich oil from wild-caught pollock to support healthy skin and coat. With prebiotics, probiotics, fiber from inulin and the most amazing grains in a high-quality blend of oats, quinoa and chia, this dry dog food offers a balanced fiber ratio to support your puppy’s digestive health. Made with 90% animal ingredients*, this high protein dog food supports muscle development and maintenance to help your large puppy grow strong. The first five ingredients of this puppy dog food are fresh or raw chicken, whole herring, whole mackerel, chicken liver and salmon, helping you maximize your puppy's nutrition with a strong source of protein, vitamins and minerals. ORIJEN's authentic WholePrey diet features the most succulent and nutrient-rich parts of the prey including poultry and organs to mimic what your puppy’s ancestors consumed in the wild. And the freeze dried coating provides a burst of flavor dogs instinctively crave. Our included fresh ingredients are delivered refrigerated and our included raw ingredients are delivered frozen. NOURISH AS NATURE INTENDED *Approximate 90%. Derived from the unprocessed state of the ingredients.

Because your dog is unique and ORIJEN™ pet foods are packed with animal protein, feeding requirements will vary with breed, environment, age and activity. That's why we suggest using the feeding guide as a starting point, and monitoring your puppy or dog’s weight and adjusting amounts as needed. We also recommend feeding your pet twice daily and always keeping fresh, clean water available. When switching diets, transitioning slowly will give your pet’s digestive system time to adjust to the nutrient-levels in ORIJEN. Over a 10-14 day period, gradually mix in ORIJEN, increasing the amount each day so that by the end you are feeding 100% ORIJEN. See your veterinarian regularly. To help maintain freshness, we recommend sealing the bag tightly and storing it in a cool, dry location.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, PureVita™ Chicken and Brown Rice Entrée combines tasty real chicken with wholesome rice and a select variety of nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita™ entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• PureVita limited ingredient diets feature a single source animal protein. Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.
 
• PureVita diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion.
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include our proprietary Good 4 Life prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.
 
• Family owned means we make decisions based on what's best for your family pets!

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty. At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition. That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Scientifically formulated and solution-focused, PureVita Lamb & Pumpkin Grain Free Dog Food combines tasty real lamb, pumpkin and a select variety of other nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages excluding growth of large size dogs (70 lbs. or more as an adult). 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion.
 
• PureVita limited ingredient diets feature a single source animal protein. Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Grain free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty. At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition. That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Scientifically formulated and solution-focused, PureVita Turkey & Cranberry Dog Food combines tasty real turkey, cranberries and a select variety of other nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion.
 
• PureVita limited ingredient diets feature a single source animal protein. Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty. At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition. That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life. Scientifically formulated and solution-focused, PureVita Duck & Cranberry Dog Food combines tasty real duck, cranberries and a select variety of other nutritious fruits and vegetables to deliver a healthy and delicious, easy to digest meal your pet will love. PureVita entrées feature single source animal or fish proteins in a limited ingredient diet. Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion.
 
• PureVita limited ingredient diets feature a single source animal protein. Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat.
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called BIO-MOS that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Grain inclusive formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Health & happiness start in the gut – our specialty.  At family-owned NutriSource, we believe the secret to health is successful digestion and absorption of balanced nutrition.  That’s why we focus on supporting the gut microbiome with our proprietary blend of prebiotics, probiotics, trace minerals and selenium yeast. We call our gut-focused proprietary blend Good4Life because these ingredients nourish the gut microbiome, building the ultimate foundation for a long and happy life.  Scientifically formulated, NutriSource Chicken & Pea Recipe Grain Free Dog Food includes a blend of chicken, carefully selected ingredients, and Good4Life to provide essential nutrients for optimum health and long life.  Feed with confidence knowing that you’re part of a family that loves your pets just as much as you do.  Health begins here.  Formulated to meet the nutritional levels established by the AAFCO Dog Food Nutrient Profiles for all life stages. 
 
• NutriSource diets are packed with probiotics for superior microbial digestion. These probiotics, coated on the outside of the kibble, absorb quickly and therefore colonize faster to aid in digestion. 
 
• Our diets also use a powerful prebiotic called Microbuild™ that supports the intestinal tract in removing harmful pathogenic bacteria while feeding gut flora for optimal digestion.  
 
• NutriSource products feature Bioplex trace minerals and Omega 3 & 6 fatty acids to provide fundamental nutrients to support brain function, heart health, and healthy skin and coat. 
 
• NutriSource diets contain a powerful antioxidant combination of Sel-Plex (a proprietary form of selenium yeast), DHA (Omega 3 fatty acid), and select fruits and vegetables to support proper oxidation at the cellular level.  
 
• DL Methionine, Choline Chloride, Taurine, and Carniking L-carnitine are key amino acids supplemented in NutriSource diets to nourish the heart as well as the pet’s whole body 
 
• NutriSource diets are scientifically formulated with a wide variety of digestible ingredients to allow for hassle-free rotation of proteins, fats, and carbohydrates.
 
• Our #1 ingredient is always a high-quality animal protein to build strong muscle and bones with naturally occurring glucosamine and chondroitin for strong joints.  
 
• Grain free formula delivering compact nutrition and include prebiotics and probiotics to help support a healthy gut.

sections.bodyString:
Royal Canin knows what makes your Yorkshire Terrier puppy magnificent is in the details. Although they have big dog personalities, small breed Yorkie puppies have delicate little bodies with growing, silky coats that require special care. They can benefit from the right growth formula to provide immune system support and skin and coat care, as well as aid with digestion as they take on puppyhood. 

Royal Canin Yorkshire Terrier Puppy dry dog food is tailor-made nutrition created just for your pure breed Yorkie puppy. This exclusive breed-specific diet is uniquely formulated for your Yorkshire Terrier puppy with specific nutrients to help them thrive. The unique kibble shape and texture are specially designed for your Yorkshire Terrier’s short muzzle and level bite, making it easy for them to pick up and chew. An exclusive mix of antioxidants and vitamin E supports their developing immune system and keeps their body growing strong. Optimal levels of omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, plus biotin, help give your Yorkshire Terrier’s growing long coat a beautiful shine. And high-quality proteins and prebiotics support healthy digestion to help promote optimal stool quality and reduce unpleasant stool odors. Once your Yorkshire Terrier puppy is over 10 months old, transition them to Royal Canin Yorkshire Terrier Adult dog food for precise nutrition into their adult years.

Directions for Feeding: Esbilac 2nd Step should be lapped out of a bowl, not fed from a bottle. Esbilac 2nd Step has been formulated to meet the nutritional needs of young puppies being weaned from mother, or bottle fed puppies progressing to solid foods. For best results the product should be mixed with ready to feed liquid Esbilac or reconstituted powder Esbilac to give the consistency necessary to get good food consumption. If Esbilac is not available water may be used. Fresh, clean water should always be available for drinking. It is recommended that Esbilac 2nd Step be fed until puppies are seven or eight weeks old when they can be fed commercial puppy or dog food as desired. All changes in diet should be made gradually over a period of one week. Mixing Directions: Puppies that are up on their feet and lapping from a bowl may be introduced to Esbilac 2nd Step. Begin by offering it as a thin gruel. Determine the amount of Esbilac 2nd Step powder to be fed to the puppy at each feeding using the Feeding Guidelines below. Reconstitute powder by using three parts (a pad is any measuring device, i.e. teaspoon, tablespoon or cup) liquid Esbilac or water to one pad powder for the first few days. Offer only small amounts and remove the uneaten portion after no more than 20 minutes. Puppies should be fed three times per day. Weigh the puppies at least once a week to monitor weight gain and adequacy of feeding. As puppies grow, decrease the amount of water mixed with the powder until weaning food is an oatmeal consistency. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. Feeding Guidelines: Feed puppies three times per day. Small puppies (1 lb average): 1 tablespoon powder. Medium puppies (3 lb average): 4 tablespoon powder. Large puppies (5 lb average): 5 tablespoon powder. More or less food may be needed by individual puppies to satisfy their food requirements for optimum performance. Storage: Powder does not need to be refrigerated, but should be kept covered and stored in a cool, dry place. Avoid exposure to excessive temperatures. Use before date stamped.

How many licks does it take to get through a Filled Bone? We don’t know for sure, but we are confident your power chewer will lather you with kisses for treating them to a Redbarn Filled Bone. One of our most popular treats, we take all-natural white beef femur bones and stuff them with a delectable filling. It’s the perfect pairing of taste and health, as chewing is a natural boredom-buster, stress-reliever, and plaque-remover for your dog. Once the filling is licked away, feel free to keep the bone and refill with your own fillings, like peanut butter from the pantry!

Our Filled Bone manufacturing process is a unique blend of state-of-the-art technology and handcrafted quality. First, the all-natural beef femur bones are bathed in industrial steel vats, allowing the bones to naturally clean themselves. Then, they’re oven-roasted for maximum safety. Finally, we hand-fill every bone through a proprietary process, allowing our original Filled Bones to stay semi-moist and perfectly placed, adhering to bone walls instead of carpets.

One of our most popular treats, we take all-natural white beef femur bones and stuff them with a delectable filling. sections.bodyString:
How many licks does it take to get through a Filled Bone? We don’t know for sure, but we are confident your power chewer will lather you with kisses for treating them to a Redbarn Filled Bone. One of our most popular treats, we take all-natural white beef femur bones and stuff them with a delectable filling. It’s the perfect pairing of taste and health, as chewing is a natural boredom-buster, stress-reliever, and plaque-remover for your dog. Once the filling is licked away, feel free to keep the bone and refill with your own fillings, like peanut butter from the pantry!

Our Filled Bone manufacturing process is a unique blend of state-of-the-art technology and handcrafted quality. First, the all-natural beef femur bones are bathed in industrial steel vats, allowing the bones to naturally clean themselves. Then, they’re oven-roasted for maximum safety. Finally, we hand-fill every bone through a proprietary process, allowing our original Filled Bones to stay semi-moist and perfectly placed, adhering to bone walls instead of carpets.

For Mixing Goats Milk Esbilac (GME) Powder: Gently stir or shake 1 part powdered GME into 2 parts warm water (a part is a teaspoon, tablespoon or cup). Do not mix more GME than can be consumed in 24 hours. Do not use a blender. Reconstituted GME should be kept refrigerated. One 5.25 oz (150 g) can of powder makes approximately 20 oz (600 ml) of liquid mixed 1:2. For Feeding: All puppies should receive their mother's milk for at least 2 days, if possible. This colostrum milk gives extra nutrition and temporary immunity against some diseases. Warm reconstituted GME to room or body temperature before serving. Feed puppies 2 tablespoons (30 ml) of liquid GME per 4 ounces (115 g) of body weight daily. The daily feeding amount should be divided into equal portions for each feeding. Puppies' needs will vary and this amount may have to be increased or decreased depending on the individual. Young and/or weak puppies should be fed every 3 to 4 hours. Older puppies can do well being fed every 8 hours. Weigh the puppies 3 times per week to assure adequate feeding. Consult your veterinarian for additional advice. The PetAg 2 oz (60 ml) or 4 oz (120 ml) small animal nurser are suited for feeding most puppies. When puppies are old enough in lap, begin offering reconstituted GME in a saucer. During the 5th week mix reconstituted GME with Esbilac 2nd Step puppy weaning food. Use of the GME and 2 step will allow the puppy to be gradually switched to solid food. Pregnant and lactating bitches: feed 2 teaspoons (4 g) GME powder per 5 lbs (2.2 kg) body weight daily. Growing puppies already on solid food, show dogs, and/or convalescing dogs: feed 1 teaspoon (2 g) GME powder per 5 lbs (2.2 kg) body weight daily by top dressing food. Storage: Unopened powder should be stored in a cool, dry place. Reconstituted liquid must be kept refrigerated for up to 24 hours. Opened powder must be refrigerated for up to 3 months, or can be frozen for up to 6 months to preserve freshness. Use before date stamped on top or bottom.

Feeding guide: Remove foil seal and tray. Drop feeding block(s) into the aquarium. See chart for number of blocks recommended. Depending on the number of fish in your tank, the feeder block might not be fully consumed when you return from vacation. The feeder does not disintegrate on its own; food is released as fish nibble on the block. If there is food left you can leave the block in the tank and resume normal feeding regimens (i.e. TetraMin®). If you keep particularly large, hungry fish such as loaches or large Cichlids you can add another feeding block to the recommended amount.
